recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle, gritty urban scene featuring three figures in the foreground with their backs to the camera, wearing colorful varsity jackets (green, white, red), standing before a weathered, two-story brick house under a dark, overcast sky.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground figures acting as a visual barrier to the background structure
High-contrast color pop of jackets against the desaturated, earthy tones of the house
Symmetrical arrangement of the three figures creating a stable triangular base
Low-angle perspective emphasizing the height and imposing nature of the architecture
coreInvariants: Dilapidated brick architecture with boarded windows
Three-person grouping with arms linked or close proximity

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects occupy the lower half of the frame at a large scale, cropped at the waist.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central white jacket acts as the primary focal point due to its brightness and central placement.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the bright jackets upward to the house facade, then to the typography at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark, moody sky provides negative space for the primary title text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated browns, grays, and tans of the brick house and sky.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant emerald green and crimson red of the outer jackets.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white of the central jacket and typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the foreground subjects vs. low saturation and dark values in the background environment.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid bright blues or yellows in the environment
Maintain a muddy, weathered texture in background colors

letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses a high-contrast transitional serif with sharp terminals
Secondary text uses a wide, geometric sans-serif with heavy tracking
A slash or strike-through element is used in the primary title for character
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'O' in the main title features a diagonal strike-through

composition.relationshipToImage: Floating on top of the sky

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for the name paired with a wide, monospaced-style sans-serif for the title.

preserve: The contrast between white and red text colors

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Times New Roman or Bodoni variant
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast serif look of the primary name
Matches the wide, technical feel of the subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-angle photograph of three men from behind, wearing green, white, and red varsity jackets with numbers on the back. They stand in front of a weathered, two-story abandoned brick house with boarded windows. The sky is dark and moody. Apply a gritty, high-contrast texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large white serif title in the top left with a diagonal line through the 'O'. Add a red, wide-spaced sans-serif subtitle to the right of the main title.

verificationChecks: Are the three jacket colors distinct (Green, White, Red)?
Is the house sufficiently dilapidated and central?
Is the subtitle tracking wide enough?

mustAchieve: Strong color separation between subjects and background

postGenerationChecks: Check for 3 distinct figures in the foreground
Ensure the house looks weathered and abandoned
Verify the typography hierarchy (Large Serif vs Small Wide Sans)
Confirm the low-angle perspective is maintained
Check that the sky is dark and desaturated
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Decay + Streetwear Triad + Low Angle + High Contrast Serif Typography
